text:
anya: quick flag FYI  I rolled out the reduced batching-delay (3ms -> 1ms) to improve median latency for long sequences and we're seeing an unexpected p95 regression for short chat flows (<120 tokens).

leon: interesting, do you have batch size histograms or smallwrite counts?

anya: yes. quick numbers from canary: avg_batch_size: 1.9 -> 1.2, p50_latency: -6ms, p95_latency: +9ms, small_write_calls/sec: +32%, grpc-send-window-stalls: +14%. kv_evictions/sec: +18%.

noah: that pattern smells like more tiny batches increasing writev/syscall pressure and also increasing concurrent key churn across kvcache shards. Lower batch delay helped large seqs but increased fragmentation for many small requests.

maya: do we know route breakdown? which product is hitting short chats the most?

anya: chat-ui route is ~65% of the short traffic during peak. I pushed a sampling run:
```
./perf/harness replay --trace traces/chat_short_peak.json --rps 250 --target canary:8080 --out /tmp/repro
pprof: go tool pprof -http=:6061 /tmp/repro/ingest.pb
```

leon: what about a coalescer in the ingress proxy that buffers tiny writes for up to X microseconds or until the writev buffer hits Y bytes? That would reduce syscall churn without increasing app-level batch delay.

noah: +1. We already have an earlier writev_coalesce helper but it's disabled for the new batching path. Re-enabling with a tiny deadline (50microsec) could hide the fragmentation cheaply. Also consider per-route adaptive delay: if route_percentile(p90_seq_len) < 32 then use longer batching-delay; otherwise keep 1ms.

maya: agree on two parallel experiments: (A) proxy writev coalescer toggle; (B) per-route batching threshold. A is the fastest.

anya: I'll open PR for the coalescer re-enable and a small proxy config: runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4670 (coalescer toggle + metrics). Also experimenting with per-route thresholds in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4672 (wip).

deploy-bot: deploy queued: runtime/canary -> v2026.03.15-rc2 (pr/4670) by anya. ETA 8m. :rocket:

perf-bot: regression test added: perf/chat-short-coalesce (250rps)  baseline saved.

leon: add metrics we can alert on: ingress_smallwrite_rate, batch_size_p50/p90, kvcache_evictions/sec, proxy_writev_coalesced_ratio. If coalescer fixes it we keep it and then iterate on selector/batching model.

noah: I'll run the replay after canary lands and post p50/p95/p99 diffs. If coalescer only reduces syscall rate without hurting median, it's a keeper. Otherwise we'll fallback and try per-route thresholds.

anya: post-deploy quick result: canary shows small_write_calls/sec down 28%, p95 for chat route back to baseline, kv_evictions down 15%. Looks promising.

maya: great. follow-ups: instrument adaptive per-route batching as an experiment (no traffic flip), and schedule a selector sweep to ensure kernel choice isn't exacerbating this.

anya: created GH issues: runtime#2011 (proxy-coalesce), runtime#2012 (per-route-batching), runtime#2013 (selector-sweep). Closing thread unless new regressions crop up. :thumbsup:
